R2A-deer-atv-0005.name: 820 m SE of Tamihi Creek
R2A-deer-atv-0005.pressureWhy: Busier: under 30 minutes from a city (estimate).
R2A-deer-atv-0005.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Chilliwack Tamihi Creek FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Deer here are black tailed deer, the coast form of mule deer: the synopsis calls them "mule (black-tailed) deer" (99%, Rule Book: Region 2 Lower Mainland).
Mule deer winter range u-2-006 unit CL 28-31 (official), 450 m N. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2012 (14 years old), right here.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHms3): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 2-3, Region 2 Lower Mainland. Near the MU line: check the MU map.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 2 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from City of Delta, about 116 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.00891, -121.77765, where the truck road ends (Chilliwack Tamihi Creek FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 1.8 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 90 m SE, climb about 23 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2012 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-3, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R2A-deer-atv-0005.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 2-3: about 1,139 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.05 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 23 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
